No faults are reported from this clip, and nothing was guessed. Three things stopped the analysis:

text.tspan: Pose found, but seen from the front
and cut off below the knees.

svg.text: AIcoach reads only down-the-line clips: film from behind your hands, along the target line.
ankles and feet missing in 100 % of frames
Hip and posture measurements need the whole body and the club, head to feet, for the full swing.
120 fps or higher is recommended. Use slow-motion mode on your phone.
Rejections never contain faults. It stays in your analyses so you can compare next time.
No verified fault found + unverified observation (UJ-3)
All three rule-table checks came in under their thresholds. Nothing is forced to fit.
Hand path stayed on or below the backswing path. Capped at medium: hand path only.
Weight appears to move toward the trail side at the top.
Outside the rule table, so no drill and no mobility exercise.
Take it to a coach to confirm before you change anything.
